rules.statement: Every application repository MUST declare the standards repositories and immutable revisions it adopts in architecture-baseline.json.
rules.verification: tooling/check_adoption.py passes against the declared baseline
rules.applies_when: a repository adopts any Slight76 standards handbook

rules.statement: Each solution MUST identify its business capability and accountable owner.
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope
rules.note: Enterprise layer retired by ADR-0028; see standards-marketplace governance.

rules.statement: Applications MUST communicate through documented contracts and identify data owners.
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope
rules.note: Enterprise layer retired by ADR-0028; see standards-marketplace governance.

rules.statement: Technology selections SHOULD follow a supported lifecycle and require justification for new platforms.
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope
rules.note: Enterprise layer retired by ADR-0028; see standards-marketplace governance.

rules.statement: Solutions MUST record accountable business, technical, operational, and data ownership responsibilities.
rules.verification: Ownership register with actual names before production
rules.applies_when: a solution adopts team architecture standards
rules.note: Enterprise layer retired by ADR-0028; see standards-marketplace governance.

rules.statement: Adopted technologies MUST have lifecycle, cost, and migration ownership.
rules.applies_when: a solution adopts team architecture standards
rules.note: Enterprise layer retired by ADR-0028; see standards-marketplace governance.

rules.statement: Material cross-boundary changes MUST maintain decision and application-baseline traceability.
rules.verification: ADR impact and adoption register review
rules.applies_when: a solution adopts team architecture standards
